Dan Barrett is a young instrumentalist who is keeping the tradition of classic jazz alive. He has become the premier trombonist of his generation. Since his start in the Los Angeles area in the 70s, he has performed and recorded with Benny Goodman, Woody Herman and the New York Pops Orchestra. His soloing and arranging can be heard on frequent recordings from Arbors Records. Dan was joined by his friend trumpet master Wendell Brunious for a conversation at the end of the interview.
Michael Woods interviewed Dan at the Los Angeles Classic Jazz Festival on September 3, 1995. Monk Rowe was also present for the interview.
We are here today filming our Jazz Archives for Hamilton College. We have with us today a fabulous trombone player, Dan Barrett. Pleased to meet you.
Tell us what brought you particularly to this festival of what they call classic jazz.
